text:
Maya Chen: heads-up — were planning a public announce + press preview next Thu 11:00am PT. need final changelog URL, docs anchor, short bench hero line, and inbound routing rules for webinar signups. who picks up eng handoff?
Samira Khan: Ill draft the hero copy and the press one-pager. need canonical docs link + 1-line bench stat we can put in the tweet and slide.
Alex Rivera: I can own changelog publishing. propose changelog freeze Wed 4pm PT, docs live Wed 11:59pm PT. will avoid internal codenames.
Rohit Mehta: eng ok with timeline. bench context: tests on g5.12x, seq_len=2048, batch=16, warm cache. measured p99 down 15.6%, token cost down 20.4% after quant-C. raw numbers: p99 -15.57%, token cost -20.37%.
Samira Khan: marketing will round to: "~16% lower p99 latency; ~20% lower token cost." will include hardware & test config in appendix.
Maya Chen: press preview: mute public channels until Thu 11:00 PT. Samira: send embargoed assets to PR on Wed 9am PT. PR wants an executive quote + methodology appendix.
Samira Khan: will prepare an executive quote and attach a short methodology note. also need a webinar CTA with UTM for inbound routing and a hidden `lead_tier` field computed client-side.
Alex Rivera: for embed fields, eng exposes: account_id, inferred_region, plan_hint. field names: account_id, inferred_region, plan_hint.
Maya Chen: inbound routing rules: if company_size>50 OR plan_hint=="enterprise" -> route to SDR-Enterprise; edu/gov -> Partnerships; otherwise route to Marketing-Nurture. Samira add hidden `lead_tier`.
Samira Khan: will add and pass to HubSpot. CTA idea: "Register for the 9/26 technical deep-dive" link: https://redwood.ai/webinar?utm_source=announce&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=release1761&lead_tier={lead_tier}&account_id={account_id}
Rohit Mehta: rollout plan: canary at t0 (5%), ramp to 30% at +45m, 100% at +2h if metrics ok. monitor p99, error_rate, token_cost. fallback: `fallback_policy: auto_revert_on_error(1.35x)`.
release-bot: scheduled canary for 2025-09-25T11:00:00-07:00, watch 120m, notify: #eng-oncall #eng-sre.
Maya Chen: press asks for bench visuals — Samira can you include a comparative bar chart and a small explainer of the workload? need PNG+SVG for the press kit.
Samira Khan: sure. Ill attach bench PNG/SVG and a short caption: "Measured on g5.12x, seq_len=2048, batch=16, warm cache; p99 down ~16%, token cost ~20%."
Alex Rivera: I'll drop the final docs link here when live: https://docs.redwood.ai/release/1761#changelog by Wed 23:50 PT.
Maya Chen: timeline recap: Wed 16:00 changelog freeze, Wed 23:59 docs live, Thu 09:00 embargoed mail to press & beta, Thu 11:00 public announce + blog + social + webinar modal. Samira post drafts Wed 12:00 PT for review.
Samira Khan: acknowledged  aiming for Wed noon drafts. will mark assets EMBARGOED for PR and include a press contact. :newspaper_roll:
